activity.notes: Joe Medicine Crow was appointed Crow tribal historian in 1948 and became a major custodian of Apsáalooke history and culture. He was also recognized as the last traditional Crow war chief after completing the four required war deeds during World War II. ATLAS reuses the existing Crow Nation polity and records his formal long-term representative service rather than treating him as principal chief or sovereign ruler.
